summary.text: One of the forty-four suitors from Zacynthus in Apollodorus' catalogue — distinct from Ormenus father of Amyntor in Phoenix's genealogy at the court of Peleus.

story.text: Apollodorus names Ormenus among the wooers assigned to Zacynthus, listed after Periphus and before the repeated Polybus entry that closes with Andromedes in Epitome 7.29.
